title: TCF practice: Food, shopping and quantities
summary: Listen for two key details about food, shopping and quantities.

lesson.title: TCF practice: Food, shopping and quantities
lesson.subtitle: A2 · Listening · 3 min

steps.fr: Je vais acheter des lentilles sèches. J'en prends un sachet pour le groupe.
steps.question: What amount will the speaker buy?
steps.explain: The speaker says un sachet; four refers to the people.

steps.fr: Je n'achète pas de boisson sans sucre. Je vais en choisir une autre pour le groupe.
steps.question: What will the speaker choose?
steps.explain: The speaker will choose another drink.
